title: P ZERO Race TLR
notes: Official tech specs read 2026-11-01 (black): 26-622 290 g, 28-622 315 g, 30-622 335 g, 32-622 375 g, 35-622 400 g, 40-622 445 g; 120 TPI SpeedCORE casing; SmartEVO compound described as giving grip in any weather. Classic and Retro editions differ slightly in weight. Pirelli calls it the first tire with tubeless technology entirely made in Italy. No hookless statement or maximum pressure on the page.
